title: Meta reportedly rents Google Cloud TPU chips in multibillion-dollar deal

sources.quote: Meta Platforms Inc. has reportedly agreed to a multibillion-dollar deal to rent Google Cloud’s custom artificial intelligence chips, according to a report in The Information today.

explain: Meta reportedly agreed to rent Google's TPU AI chips through Google Cloud to train its next models, as it tries to rely less on Nvidia. Reports call it multibillion-dollar but give no exact figure, and the companies have not announced it.
